dialogs.exportDbConfirmDetail: The export contains every saved conversation and PDF document. Encrypting the output is strongly recommended — without encryption the file is plaintext and includes any personal information stored in the database.
dialogs.exportDbPassphraseTitle: Set Passphrase for Encrypted DB Export
dialogs.exportDbPassphraseHint: This passphrase is the only way to decrypt the file. Monadic Chat cannot recover it. Minimum 8 characters.
dialogs.exportDbEncryptedSuccess: Encrypted Document DB written to monadic-qdrant.tar.gz.enc. Keep the passphrase safe — it cannot be recovered.
dialogs.exportDbEncryptedFailed: Encryption failed. The plain tarball (monadic-qdrant.tar.gz) is left in place.
dialogs.importDbConfirmMessage: Replace the current Document DB with the imported file?
dialogs.importDbConfirmDetail: Importing OVERWRITES all currently saved conversations, PDFs, and Knowledge Base entries. The current data cannot be recovered after import. Make sure the file (~/monadic/data/monadic-qdrant.tar.gz or monadic-qdrant.tar.gz.enc) is from a trusted source.
dialogs.importDbPassphraseHint: Enter the passphrase used when the file was exported.
dialogs.importDbDecryptFailed: Decryption failed. Wrong passphrase, or the file has been modified.
